## Public-reporting status in the outcome window
- The registrant continued to file periodic reports on Form 10-K through the outcome
  window; the reports for fiscal years 2021 and 2022 are the entity's own annual reports
  (not a successor's or acquirer's consolidated filing). [SRC: SEC accession 0001058623-22-000028, Form 10-K FY2021] [SRC: SEC accession 0001058623-23-000010, Form 10-K FY2022]

## Realized financial trajectory
- For fiscal year 2021, the registrant reported net income of $17.3 million, versus a
  net loss of $59.7 million for fiscal year 2020; Adjusted EBITDA was $134.9 million for
  2021 versus $81.3 million for 2020. [SRC: SEC accession 0001058623-22-000028, Form 10-K FY2021 MD&A]
- For fiscal year 2022, the registrant reported net income of $16.2 million (a $1.0
  million decrease from 2021); net revenue increased $37.0 million (4.0%) year over
  year, driven by higher spot broadcast, political, and digital advertising revenue; and
  Adjusted EBITDA rose to $166.0 million (up 23.1% from 2021). [SRC: SEC accession 0001058623-23-000010, Form 10-K FY2022 MD&A]

  its FCC broadcast licenses; during fiscal year 2022 it recorded a further $15.5 million
  impairment charge on FCC broadcast licenses. [SRC: SEC accession 0001058623-22-000028, Form 10-K FY2021 Risk Factors] [SRC: SEC accession 0001058623-23-000010, Form 10-K FY2022 Risk Factors]

- As of December 31, 2021, the registrant's workforce comprised 3,488 people, of whom
  2,588 were employed full-time. [SRC: SEC accession 0001058623-22-000028, Form 10-K FY2021 Business/Human Capital]
- As of February 16, 2022 and again as of February 16, 2023, Mary G. Berner was listed
  as the registrant's President and Chief Executive Officer in both the FY2021 and
  FY2022 Form 10-K executive-officer tables. [SRC: SEC accession 0001058623-22-000028, Form 10-K FY2021 Executive Officers] [SRC: SEC accession 0001058623-23-000010, Form 10-K FY2022 Executive Officers]

- No going-concern qualification, additional bankruptcy filing, or divestiture of the
  overall broadcast business was found in the fiscal 2021 or 2022 Form 10-K text
  reviewed; absence of a disclosure is not itself proof of absence of the underlying
  event and is noted here as a scope limitation of the documents grepped. [UNVERIFIED]

## Outcome summary (realized record only)
- Across the fixed ~3.7-4.7-year outcome window (fiscal years 2021-2022), the registrant
  remained an SEC-reporting, self-filing entity that returned to net income (from a
  fiscal-2020 net loss) and grew net revenue and Adjusted EBITDA, while also continuing
  to record periodic FCC-license impairment charges ($4.5 million in FY2020, $15.5
  million in FY2022); the same named individual held the Chief Executive Officer title
  throughout the window. [SRC: SEC accession 0001058623-22-000028, Form 10-K FY2021 MD&A] [SRC: SEC accession 0001058623-23-000010, Form 10-K FY2022 MD&A]

[SLICE END]
